property.statement: Legacy DomainPlugin discovery uses Core's shared collector with stable source ordering and rejects non-DomainPlugin or malformed-metadata candidates. For the supported Economics profile, one actual call through PolisySimulator.train invokes the existing native actor-critic trainer, persists the resulting policy through the selected tenant CAS, reloads it, and changes the same-observation action. The existing backend runtime-fingerprint owner supplies the observed JAX device and determinism tier before training; missing or tier/device-inconsistent profiles are held, and the same observed tier is used for strict artifact readback. Unsupported composite training stays bridge_pending. Rollout evaluation remains a SimulationResult over trajectory; its [2,2,2] per-agent rewards are never presented as PPO loss.
runtime_path: native result -> tenant-scoped CAS via store_policy_artifact -> load_policy_artifact readback -> independent deterministic action oracle and simulator policy consumption
unsupported profile -> TrainingResult(status=bridge_pending) -> CLI reason and nonzero process status
property.proxy_divergence: The pre-fix Economics adapter hardcoded STRICT_CPU while the native trainer's validate_for_tier path only warned; on a GPU runtime this could stamp a CPU-tier artifact without enforcing CPU execution (P38). The frozen candidate now recomputes the profile through the existing runtime-fingerprint owner, checks tier/device consistency before training/publication, and passes the same tier to trainer and readback. The CPU numerical run confirms its runtime-observed profile matches the persisted artifact fingerprint. Separately, a trained status, finite loss, artifact reference, CAS persistence, or plugin-supplied .verified=True flag can remain when a policy effect or owner-issued verification is absent. The optimizer-removal probe keeps success markers and replaces the native optimizer result with the unchanged actor; the independently loaded saved-action assertion fails. Discovery exposes no registry verification/admission artifact or verifier-provenance consumer; a candidate's arbitrary Python attribute remains untrusted.
negative_controls: reverse entry-point sequence and filesystem child order; stable duplicate winner is alpha and entry-point names sort
malformed metadata returning None and factory returning object() are rejected; direct registry calls reject non-DomainPlugin and absent metadata
candidate-added verified=True does not create registry verification state or an owner-issued admission artifact
unsupported Economics composite and controlled reward-evaluation fixture cannot enter the native optimizer and return bridge_pending with no policy, artifact, or loss
optimizer-removal control retains trained/loss/artifact/CAS/readback markers but the true saved-action oracle fails
foreign tenant cannot read the persisted policy manifest
property.reward_characterization: Real PolisySimulator.run(3) returns a four-state trajectory. The controlled plugin supplies per-agent rewards [2,2,2] on each of three transitions. CompositeReward.total is the mean across agents (2 per transition); summing three evaluations yields 6. SimulationResult has no reward_history field, so this records the existing trajectory/reward consumer and does not add a history DTO or assert durable historical reward storage.

capability_state_or_finding_state: PLG-01/LA-022 is limited; the discovery behavior is tested, but verification_missing remains for owner-issued admission and verifier provenance. PLG-02/PLG-03 provide a bounded real Economics one-call trainer-to-tenant-CAS readback path and honest bridge_pending for unsupported profiles. LA-023 remains partial/semantic_test_missing overall; this receipt does not close either finding or ratify a broader public training promise.

pattern_pass.existing_failure_modes: Discovery had separate source paths and candidate validation gaps; legacy training reported rollout rewards as if they were optimizer losses and could return an unchanged policy as trained. Review also found a P38 runtime-profile proxy: the adapter hardcoded STRICT_CPU while the native helper only emitted tier-validation warnings.
